name: Lupinus Oersted
original_name: ルピナス・エールステッド
source:
The prince of the neighboring country of Oersted. A boy possessed by the flame fairy Prominence. He has a strong power due to the fairy possessing him.

He has a free-spirited and elusive personality, and while he often tells Alice that he likes her, he doesn't mind doing terrible things.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/midorino_himegimi.html#chara]official website[/url]]
